name: Tablet of Destinies
lore: Whoever holds the Tablet of Destinies controls the fate of all things. Enlil kept it in his sanctuary; Anzu the storm-bird stole it and plunged the world into chaos. Ninurta slew Anzu and returned it. The Tablet allows its bearer to reject fate once per floor — when a question is answered wrongly, the Tablet cracks and offers a different question. A second chance, drawn from the well of all possible futures.
